description: This file defines the GrainTimerCreationOptions struct, which provides configuration options for creating grain timers in Orleans. It includes properties for due time, period, interleaving behavior, and whether to keep the grain alive.

classes.name: GrainTimerCreationOptions
classes.description: A readonly struct that encapsulates options for creating grain timers, including timing intervals and behavior flags.

methods.name: GrainTimerCreationOptions
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the options with specified due time and period.
